hook: Flexible rubber turbine blades match pitch-controlled rigid ones in yield with a third less load jitter
hook_turn: with a third less load jitter
summary: Blades that bend at the trailing edge flatten under load, passively easing fatigue-causing fluctuations by up to one-third. In experiments over simulated tidal cycles, energy yield matched rigid blades with active pitch control. Tests were lab-scale with simulated tides, not a turbine at sea.
title: Flexible rubber blades for tidal turbines.
